messages:
Maya SRE: Postmortem follow-up — we observed a repeating pattern: p95 latency spikes plus short throughput drops for text-gen in us-west (3 incidents in 5d). Need clear remediation owners, short timelines, and a temp SLO/SLA plan while we stabilize.

Dan Smith: I extracted traces; pattern shows KV-cache churn + backend queueing during large batch storms. Also saw model-serving GC pauses in one trace. I'll own dashboard panels + trace links.

Priya Anand: I'll take cache eviction policy + LRU tuning (ETA Tue EOD). I'll also instrument a per-pool eviction-rate metric.

Rachel P: Error-budget trending looks bad if this continues. We should prepare a 24h emergency SLO slack, but couple it with a synchronized rollout pause and an A/B rollback guard.

Tim (Platform): I'll put a temporary throttle on max_batch=64 for the next two deploys and add a circuit-breaker for oversized requests (low risk). Can do today.

Dan Smith: Dashboard plan: per-pool p95, p99, request-size histogram, and an "error-budget burn by route" panel. Grafana p95-by-pool query I'll add: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"text-gen\"}[5m])) by (le, pool))
```
ETA: Mon 11:00.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-9999 "us-west text-gen: recurring tail spikes - dashboards, cache tuning, throttle + SLO window" assigned to Priya/Dan/Tim. Canary deploys scheduled.

Maya SRE: Emergency SLO proposal (short): relax p95 target by +50ms for a 24h window, add throughput slack +5%, and auto-revert if additional error-budget burn >4% during the window. Also require a manual signoff to extend. Draft snippet added to runbook.

Rachel P: Add gating rules: pause all noncritical rollouts, and if any route consumes >30% of remaining error budget during the window auto-rollback the last deploy. We need explicit customer-comm wording too.

Priya Anand: A note on runtime: I'll add LRU bump and expose eviction_rate metric by Tue EOD. If we still see evictions we'll try a conservative cache-size increase.

Tim (Platform): Batch cap deployed to canary already. Also added a lightweight circuit-breaker that returns 429 for >max_batch. Monitoring link: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123 (will paste full links in RED-9999).

Dan Smith: Pushed dashboards and alerted rules. New alert: sustained p95 delta >30ms for 15m -> P2 page with runbook pointer. Also added an "error budget burn rate" alert when burn rate >0.02 for 10m.

Maya SRE: I've updated ops runbook with the emergency SLO clause and rollout gating. YAML snippet in PR: 
```yaml
emergency_slo_override:
  p95_delta_ms: 50
  window_hours: 24
  throughput_slack_pct: 5
  auto_rollback_on_extra_budget_pct: 4
  require_manual_extend: true
```
PR: https://git.redwood/infra/runbooks/pull/1412

ops-bot: RED-9999 updated with checklists and owners.

Rachel P: Plan recap: Priya -> cache tuning + metrics (Tue EOD), Dan -> dashboards/alerts (Mon 11:00), Tim -> batch-cap + circuit-breaker (deployed to canary today), Maya -> runbook + SLO PR (done), Rachel -> rollout pause + comms draft (today). Reconvene Wed 09:30 to review telemetry and decide permanent SLO/SLA edits.

Maya SRE: If telemetry still shows recurrence after these steps we'll escalate to per-pool throughput quotas and consider a temporary model-variant rollback. Closing with action items in RED-9999. See you Wed. :calendar:
